sentence: This project develops theory and computer methods for sparse sensing, so that models of nuclear reactor components can match real physical behavior.
This project uses a mass spectrometer and an imaging system to study how toxicant mixtures affect fish and where pesticides spread within native bee species.
This project builds a compiler that maps quantum algorithms onto quantum computing hardware so quantum computers run faster and more accurately.
This project tries to find out how grain size in complex concentrated alloys made by additive manufacturing affects strength and ductility.
This project studies how soil microbiomes keep their functions when pH changes, focusing on how bacteria reduce nitrate in soil.
This project builds and studies an upper division mathematics course about dynamical systems and modeling for prospective secondary teachers.
This project studies weaknesses in wireless network security designs that use wireless channel properties, and designs defenses against attacks.
This project studies how to use electrochemistry to make metal nanoclusters with the same number of atoms directly on a conductive support.
This project explores robot-rooms, which are rooms that change configuration and physically interact with the people inside, using prototypes and user studies.
This project builds and tests computer models for designing DNA nanostructures, including mirror-image DNA made to resist degradation in cells.
This project develops a College Credit Certificate focused on cybersecurity and tests whether offering it makes a difference in who it attracts.
This project tests a technology that combines quantum computing with artificial intelligence to find abnormal structures in complex medical scans.
This project tries to find out which environmental neighborhoods shape where birds occur across North America, and why birds use them.
This project develops graph neural networks that work on very large datasets and speed up computer solutions of partial differential equations.
This project uses graph theory and molecular modeling to study how the RNA frameshifting element in coronaviruses is structured and how it works.
This project builds a virtual reality system controlled by voice that lets researchers ask questions about scanned plants and see the answers.
This project tries to find the enzymes that fungi use to build terpenoid mycotoxins, and how those enzymes work.
This project builds a lightweight in-memory distributed ledger that keeps data consistent in extreme-scale systems used for scientific computing.
